disclaimer.title: Before We Begin…
disclaimer.subtitle: Just a few things to know about Kibun
disclaimer.body: Kibun is here to help you with self-reflection and mood tracking — and to gently show you which daily habits seem to shift how you feel. Think of it as a cozy journal companion.
